description: PER-FILE type-error baseline for apps/operator (mirrors packages/operator-core/.tsc-baseline.json, apps/operator-vite/.tsc-baseline.json and libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/.tsc-baseline.json, P-010/WI-4535/EI-847). A file whose current error count exceeds its baseline here is a NEW, ATTRIBUTED regression and gates lint:tsc:operator (the gate NAMES the file).
note: SEEDED 2026-08-02 (EI-19312097806511163 / EI-19346987162238063): apps/operator had NO tsconfig-scoped typecheck gate of any kind before this — test:affected is type-blind (esbuild/Vitest), lint:tsc covers packages/operator-core only, and the operator-vite SPA build transpiles without full type-checking. `npx tsc -p apps/operator/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false` reported several hundred pre-existing errors at seed time, none triaged or fixed as part of establishing this gate (unlike the orchestrator's WI-6826/WI-6838 pass, which fixed its 2 production-source errors before seeding). This baseline is therefore a RATCHET START, not a clean-room zero: it exists so no NEW error can enter silently, while the standing debt is paid down over time via `npm run lint:tsc:operator -- --update` as files are fixed. NOT YET a green-checkpoint gate leg (see EI-19375134577577530 / EI-19372643177590910 — wiring a new project into the release gate is a separate, higher-blast-radius change deliberately deferred).
